runner: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free via the opencode agent
notes: Three.js r160 via jsDelivr importmap with EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass and OutputPass. Moonlit graveyard street set (moon, stars, fog cards, tombstones, dead trees, iron fence, a lit distant house) with ACES tone mapping, exponential fog and a five-lamp rig of keys, gels and a shadow-casting key. Michael Jackson, Pepe the Frog, Donald Trump and Elon Musk are articulated rigs (hips, torso, neck, head, two-bone arms and legs) posed by a 112 BPM beat clock: zombie arms, moonwalk, the thumb-to-mouth point and a group groove, plus a silhouetted chorus line. A twelve-shot camera list cuts on musical boundaries, with manual wide, orbit, close, low-angle and free cameras, transport bar, letterbox and an optional synth score. Verified in Chrome: no console errors.
